title: errorsummary link text equals field error
rule: ErrorSummary link text = the field’s error text — same wording in both places so either context still reads.
pass_when: Each ErrorSummary link uses the same wording as that field’s error text.
fail_when: Summary link wording differs from the field error (e.g. only the field label in the summary).
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil; MULTI_HOME picked explain_failure_next_to_cause; leftover harvest tag recover_from_invalid_input
do_not_claim: Submit-time default as this wording row; GOV.UK error summary as a merge that drops same-wording.
